name: journey-map-animator
description: 滚动驱动SVG路径旅行动画生成器
interaction: Users draw or import an SVG path representing a travel route, then scroll the page to animate an icon (e.g., a plane, car, or pin) along the path with progress-based visual cues. Waypoints along the route reveal location details, photos, and milestones as the animated traveler reaches each point, creating an immersive scroll-driven storytelling experience.
